name: Dublin Airport

runway.v: longest runway 10L/28R, 3,109 m long and 45 m wide (three runways in all)

noise.v: no general night closure was found, but the longest runway, 10L/28R, is not used for take-off or landing 23:00-07:00 except for safety and other listed reasons, and reverse thrust should not be used 23:00-06:00 local
noise.quote: Runway 10L-28R shall not be used for take-off or landing between 2300 hours and 0700 hours, except in cases of safety,

handling.v: passenger handling by Swissport, Sky Handling, Signature Flight Support (corporate), Universal Aviation (corporate), Aer Lingus and Fenix Logistics
handling.quote: Available from Swissport, Sky Handling, Signature Flight Support (Corporate), Universal Aviation (Corporate), Aer Lingus and Fenix Logistics.

deicing.v: de-icing on request from Swissport and Aer Lingus
deicing.quote: On request from Swissport and Aer Lingus

slots.v: slot-coordinated airport; every operator needs a slot from Airport Coordination Ltd (ACL) before flying to or from Dublin
slots.quote: No Operator shall operate to or from Dublin without having first obtained a slot from Airport Coordination Ltd. (ACL),

missing: curfew (no explicit 'no curfew' statement; only a runway-specific night rule, recorded under noise)
notes: Edition: Irish eAIP effective 14 May 2026, the newest found online; a later AIRAC may be in force. The 10L/28R night rule applies to that runway only, so it is recorded under noise, not curfew. US Customs and Border Protection preclearance is by prior negotiation (0700-1700). dublinairport.com had no official GA/business-aviation page found by search. Re-researched 2026-10-29: The Irish eAIP edition on file (14 May 2026) is superseded for EIDW: AIRAC AIP Amdt 008/26 (effective 6 Aug 2026) reissued EIDW AD 2 pages 1-44, changing AD 2.9, 2.19, 2.22 and 2.23 (not 2.2, 2.3 or 2.20). The newer HTML page could not be opened, so the recorded facts were not re-checked against it; later amendments after Aug 2026 were not checked. The 2026 charges document (effective 29 Mar 2026 - 27 Mar 2027) defines night for noise charges as 23:00-06:59:59 and gives no night operating ban.
